With the wrapping business now closed, this channel follows the next chapter. More travel, more cars, more experiences, and a closer look into Yianni’s life beyond the workshop.

From insane supercars and new builds to meeting people around the world and getting access to places most people never see, this channel is all about the journey as it happens.

snippet.title: BusinessCringe
snippet.description:
Corporate culture sucks. Hard.

Pointless meetings, incompetent managers, evil bosses, soulless mission statements. Do I need to go on? There’s literally nothing about modern corporate culture that doesn’t suck.

If you try to break free from that, you’re faced with an endless ocean of “How to get rich” gurus or podcast bros trying to sell you their BS courses.

It’s like no matter where you go there’s these big players making life harder for regular people who just wanna exist.

I can’t change the world, but I can at least make fun of it all.

I will NEVER try to sell you a BS course on anything. EVER.

Welcome to the world of BusinessCringe.

Business inquiries: ContactBusinessCringe@gmail.com

snippet.title: 60 Minutes Australia
snippet.description:
60 Minutes Australia was first broadcast in February 1979. Founding reporters Ray Martin, George Negus and Ian Leslie quickly established the show as the destination for the finest television journalism.  

Today, 45 years later, 60 Minutes remains Australia's leading current affairs program. Award winning correspondents Tara Brown, Amelia Adams, Adam Hegarty, Dimity Clancey and Nick McKenzie investigate, analyse and uncover the issues affecting all Australians.
